Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

analysiskit 2026.11.1

New features

  • Route analysis. Three new settings in a new List of Analysis route_analysis sheet, all FALSE by default, pool 4Mi’s repeated country and place questions and analyse them across every slot rather than slot by slot:

    • transit_country: transit countries (Q47–Q54), with Q72 and QN8.
    • places_stop: places stopped (Q56–Q70) and why.
    • dangerous_location: most dangerous locations (Q98–Q117), with incidents and perpetrators (experienced incidents only).

    Each block that is turned on gets a sheet of its own in the results workbook: Transit Countries, Places Stop and Dangerous Locations. A sheet opens with the ranking of every country, then has one wide table per follow-up question: Overall, then each country with the most respondents first (route_top_countries, default 10; 0 for all), each followed by its top places (route_top_locations, default 4), as columns, with the same table in counts alongside. Beneath each, the question is disaggregated by gender (route_gender_var, default Q27) and by every disaggregation_variables variable. Percentages are of respondents: a respondent counts once per country or place, however many slots name it. The question names are fixed, so no analysis_variables rows are needed; the slots are reshaped in memory and never saved. The new run_route_analysis() runs the same analysis from a script.

  • include_dataset. A new setting that adds the dataset the analysis was run on to the results workbook, as a dataset sheet. Off by default; the dataset is personal data, so a workbook with this sheet must be handled as such.

  • full_sample_base and full_sample_label. New settings that keep respondents who were not asked a question (for example, skipped by skip logic) in the denominator, so proportions are out of the full sample or group. The not-asked share is reported as its own row, Not asked / no response by default.

Performance

  • Under engine = "auto", rows with a level whose confidence interval is not reported in value_columns now run on the fast engine, laid out exactly as the survey engine would have laid them out. Medians and ratios with a level stay on the survey engine.
  • A dataset read from a file with a List of Analysis now reads only the columns the analysis uses.

Breaking changes

  • Two List of Analysis sheets are renamed: analysis is now analysis_variables, and group_analysis is now disaggregation_variables. Workbooks using the former names still read as before; one carrying both names for the same sheet is an error. Messages and the sheet summary use the new names, and the reader’s sheets list is keyed by them.
  • The template no longer ships an exclude_choices sheet. The feature is unchanged: add the sheet when a run needs it.

Minor changes

  • The LoA template (inst/extdata/loa_template.xlsx) and the LoA specification (inst/extdata/loa-schema.md) document every new setting.

analysiskit 2026.09.1

  • First release: the Analysis Kit workflow as a package. Reads a dataset and a List of Analysis workbook, validates them against each other, runs the analysis across every disaggregation and writes an MMC-branded Excel workbook.
